name: BULBASAUR
description: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: IVYSAUR
description: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

name: VENUSAUR
description: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

name: CHARMANDER
description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: CHARMELEON
description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: CHARIZARD
description: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: SQUIRTLE
description: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: WARTORTLE
description: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

name: BLASTOISE
description: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: CATERPIE
description: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

name: METAPOD
description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: BUTTERFREE
description: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.

name: VENIPEDE
description: It's bite injects a potent poison. It is brutally aggressive.

name: WHIRLIPEDE
description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins it's body like a wheel and crashes furiously into it's enemies.

name: SCOLIPEDE
description: Highly aggressive, it chases down it's foe with it's horns until it prevails.

name: PIDGEY
description: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

name: PIDGEOTTO
description: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: PIDGEOT
description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

name: BLITZLE
description: They use their flashing manes to communicate with each other.

name: ZEBSTRIKA
description: They have lighting-like movements. When angry, it shoots lighting in all directions.

name: RUFFLET
description: They crush berries with their talons. They will challenge anything, even strong opponents.

name: BRAVIARY
description: One can carry a car while flying. They fight for their friends without any thought of dangering themselves.

name: EKANS
description: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

name: ARBOK
description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

name: PIKACHU
description: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: RAICHU
description: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

name: ZORUA
description: It changes into forms of others to suprise them. They hide their true identities by transforming.

name: ZOROARK
description: Bonds between these pokemon are very strong. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: SOLOSIS
description: They can survive in any environment. They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic powers.

name: DUOSION
description: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these pokemon are at their max power.

name: REUNICLUS
description: These remarkable intelligent pokemon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: LITWICK
description: They shine a light that absorbs the life energy of people and POKEMON, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: LAMPENT
description: It arrives near the moment of death and steals the spirit from the body.

name: CHANDELURE
description: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. The spirits burnt up in it's ominous flames lose their way and wander forever.

name: SNOVER
description: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

name: ABOMASNOW
description: It's large and hard pincer has 10,000 horsepower strength.

name: VULPIX
description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: NINETALES
description: It has nine long tails and fur that  gleams gold. It is said to live for  1,000 years.

name: YAMASK
description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be it's face when it was a human.

name: COFAGRIGUS
description: They like to eat gold nuggets. They turn people into mummies after swallowing them.

name: ZUBAT
description: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.

name: GOLBAT
description: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.

name: GOTHITA
description: It can become so obsessed with observing something, it doesn't even notice attacks.

name: GOTHORITA
description: According to many old tales, it creates friends for itself by controlling children in their sleep.

name: GOTHITELLE
description: It can see into the future from the movement of the stars. When it learns its trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

name: PATRAT
description: Extremely cautious, they use their tails to communicate with each other.

name: WATCHOG
description: Their tails stand high. Keen eyesight let's them see in the dark.

name: MINCCINO
description: These POKEMON prefer a tidy habitat. Their tails are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: CINCINNO
description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy to deflect attacks.

name: DRILBUR
description: It can dig through the ground at 30mph.

name: EXCADRILL
description: It's steel drill is strong enough to bore through iron plates. They build mazelike nests underground.

name: MIENFOO
description: They have mastered elegant combos. They dominate with onslaughts.

name: MIENSHAO
description: It uses it's arms to strike rapidly with attacks that cannot even be seen.

name: HIPPOPOTAS
description: They form colonies of around ten. It shuts it's nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking.

name: HIPPOWDON
description: It is quick to anger. It holds it's mouth agape as a display of strength.

name: PAWNIARD
description: Blade's comprise this pokemon's entire body. They cling to their prey and inflict damage with their blades.

name: BISHARP
description: It leads a group of pawniward. It will finish off it's prey.

name: GROWLITHE
description: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: ARCANINE
description: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

name: POLIWAG
description: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: POLIWHIRL
description: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: POLIWRATH
description: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

name: ABRA
description: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

name: KADABRA
description: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.

name: ALAKAZAM
description: It does not like physical attacks very  much. Instead, it freely uses extra- sensory powers to defeat foes.

name: MACHOP
description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: MACHOKE
description: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: MACHAMP
description: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: STARLY
description: They like to form groups, however, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: STARAVIA
description: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group.

name: STARAPTOR
description: It never stops attacking, even if injured. It fusses over the shape of it's comb.

name: TENTACOOL
description: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

name: TENTACRUEL
description: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

name: GEODUDE
description: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

name: GRAVELER
description: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.

name: GOLEM
description: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

name: PONYTA
description: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: RAPIDASH
description: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.

name: SLOWPOKE
description: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: SLOWBRO
description: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

name: MAGNEMITE
description: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.

name: MAGNETON
description: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

name: AXEW
description: They use tusk to crush the berries they eat. They mark their territory with them as well.

name: FRAXURE
description: Their tusk can shatter rocks. Territory battles between them can be intensley violent

name: HAXORUS
description: These Pokemon are covered in hard armor. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel

name: DWEBBLE
description: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. This pokemon remains agitated until it finds a replacement.

name: CRUSTLE
description: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days.

name: CROAGUNK
description: It rarely fights fairly. It is a very popular mascot.

name: TOXICROAK
description: It has a poison sac at it's throat. The stored poison is churned for greater potency.

name: SHELLDER
description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: CLOYSTER
description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

name: GASTLY
description: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

name: HAUNTER
description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.

name: GENGAR
description: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

name: ONIX
description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: BRONZOR
description: There are researchers who believe this pokemon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: BRONZONG
description: It brought rains by opening up portals to another world. It is a bringer of plentiful harvests.

name: SCRAGGY
description: It headbutts anyone who makes eye contact with it. It reduces damage by pulling skin to it's neck.

name: SCRAFTY
description: It smashes concrete blocks with kicking attacks. Groups beat up anything that enters their territory.

name: RIOLU
description: It has the power to see many emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: LUCARIO
description: It senses aura to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over a half a mile away.

name: EXEGGCUTE
description: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.

name: EXEGGUTOR
description: It is called The Walking Tropical Rainforest. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

name: DARUMAKA
description: It cannot calm down and it runs around. People use them in clothes to stay warm.

name: DARMANITAN
description: Enough power to destroy a dump truck in one punch. It's internal fire burns at 2,500 F

name: HITMONLEE
description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: HITMONCHAN
description: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: LICKITUNG
description: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

name: KOFFING
description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: WEEZING
description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.

name: RHYHORN
description: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.

name: RHYDON
description: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: CHANSEY
description: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

name: TANGELA
description: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON's identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

name: KANGASKHAN
description: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.

name: HORSEA
description: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

name: SEADRA
description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

name: DUCKLETT
description: They are excellent divers. When attacked, they use feathers to splash waters.

name: SWANNA
description: It whips it's long neck to deliver forceful repeated attacks. They start to dance at dusk.

name: STARYU
description: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: STARMIE
description: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

name: SPIRITOMB
description: It's constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

name: SCYTHER
description: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

name: JYNX
description: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.

name: ELECTABUZZ
description: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: MAGMAR
description: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: PINSIR
description: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won't release until the foe is torn.

name: TAUROS
description: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.

name: MAGIKARP
description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.

name: GYARADOS
description: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: LAPRAS
description: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

name: DITTO
description: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.

name: EEVEE
description: An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.

name: VAPOREON
description: Its body's cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.

name: JOLTEON
description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: FLAREON
description: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: PORYGON
description: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial POKéMON.

name: TIRTOUGA
description: It swims skillfully and dives depths beyond half a mile.

name: CARRACOSTA
description: They can live both in the ocean and on land. It has incredible jaw strength.

name: ARCHEN
description: Said to be the ancestor of bird POKEMON. Unable to fly, it lived in treetops and hooped from one branch to another.

name: ARCHEOPS
description: It runs better then it flies. They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey.

name: AERODACTYL
description: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.

name: SNORLAX
description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: ALOMOMOLA
description: It gently holds injured Pokemon in it's fins. It's special membrane heals their wounds.

name: DURANT
description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor. They dig nests in mountains.

name: ZEN DARUMA
description: A DARMANITAN transformed into a stone statue. It meditates to sharpen it's mind and fights mentally.

name: DRATINI
description: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.

name: DRAGONAIR
description: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.

name: DRAGONITE
description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: AUDINO
description: Using the feelers on it's ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

name: MEW
description: A POKéMON of South America that was thought to have been extinct. It is very intelligent and learns any move.

name: CHIKORITA
description: Its pleasantly aromatic leaves have the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

name: BAYLEEF
description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: MEGANIUM
description: MEGANIUM's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: CYNDAQUIL
description: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

name: QUILAVA
description: This POKéMON is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: TYPHLOSION
description: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: TOTODILE
description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: CROCONAW
description: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

name: FERALIGATR
description: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

name: MUNNA
description: Always floating in the air, it eats the dreams of people and pokemon.

name: MUSHARNA
description: It can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

name: BUIZEL
description: It spins it's two tails like a screw to propel itself through water.

name: FLOATZEL
description: It is known to rescue people and carry off it's prey.

name: JOLTIK
description: It has a very tenacious nature. It's acute sense of smell let's it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: GALVANTULA
description: They create a barrier by spitting out electrical charged threads.

name: SPINARAK
description: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

name: ARIADOS
description: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

name: CROBAT
description: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

name: CHINCHOU
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: LANTURN
description: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.

name: PICHU
description: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: SHELLOS
description: Beware of pushing strongly on it's squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

name: GASTRODON
description: Long ago, it's entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it in it's cells.

name: TOGEPI
description: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.

name: TOGETIC
description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: DRIFLOON
description: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a  signpost for wandering spirits.

name: DRIFBLIM
description: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft of winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: TIMBURR
description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. They always carry squared logs.

name: GURDURR
description: Even a group of wrestlers cannot make it budge an inch.

name: CONKELDURR
description: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They taught humans how to make concrete 2,000 yrs ago.

name: EMOLGA
description: They live on treetops and glide releasing discharged electricity.

name: BOUFFALANT
description: Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: THROH
description: When encountered by a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

name: SAWK
description: It desires the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleep.

name: POLITOED
description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: ROGGENROLA
description: They were discovered a hundred years ago. Inside each one is a energy core.

name: BOLDORE
description: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on it's body glows.

name: GIGALITH
description: It fires off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: AIPOM
description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: COTTONEE
description: They go wherever the wind takes them. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract attackers.

name: WHIMSICOTT
description: Riding whirlwinds, they leave behind balls of white fluff.

name: YANMA
description: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

name: FRILLISH
description: They paralyze prey with poison. It sinks it's opponent to the ocean floor.

name: JELLICENT
description: Their favorite food is life energy. They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their body.

name: ESPEON
description: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe's next move.

name: UMBREON
description: When darkness falls, the rings on its body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

name: MURKROW
description: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: SLOWKING
description: When its head was bitten, toxins entered SLOWPOKE's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: MISDREAVUS
description: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: UNOWN
description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: WOBBUFFET
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: GALLADE
description: When trying to protect someone, it extends it's elbow as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: PINECO
description: It hangs and waits for flying-insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

name: FORRETRESS
description: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: RHYPERIOR
description: It can launch a rock held in it's hand like a missle.

name: GLIGAR
description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: STEELIX
description: It is said that if an ONIX lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: SKORUPI
description: It can survive a year without food. It's needle tip scretes poison.

name: DRAPION
description: It takes pride in it's strength. Taking down foes without using toxins.

name: GLISCOR
description: It can circle around the globe without flapping once.

name: SCIZOR
description: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: TANGROWTH
description: It's arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.

name: HERACROSS
description: Usually docile, but if disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

name: SNEASEL
description: Vicious in nature, it drives PIDGEY from their nests and feasts on the eggs that are left behind.

name: TEDDIURSA
description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: URSARING
description: With its ability to distinguish any smell, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

name: CUBCHOO
description: It's nose is always running. The mucus gets watery and it's power decreases.

name: BEARTIC
description: It can make it's breathe freeze at will. Not only that, they are very capable swimmers.

name: SWINUB
description: If it smells something enticing, it dashes off headlong to find the source of the aroma.

name: PILOSWINE
description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: GIBLE
description: It attacks using it's huge mouth. It may hurt itself out of clumsiness.

name: GABITE
description: It seaks treasures in caves and hoards it's loot in it's nest.

name: GARCHOMP
description: It is said when it runs at high speed, it's wings can create blades of wind.

name: DELIBIRD
description: It nests at the edge of sharp cliffs. It spends all day carrying food to its awaiting chicks.

name: TOGEKISS
description: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another's rights and avoid needless strife.

name: SKARMORY
description: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: HOUNDOUR
description: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: HOUNDOOM
description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: KINGDRA
description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: PHANPY
description: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

name: DONPHAN
description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take a long time to grow.

name: PORYGON2
description: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

name: MUNCHLAX
description: In a desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under it's fur.

name: DRUDDIGON
description: It warms it's body by absorbing sunlight with it's wings. The skin on it's face is harder than rock.

name: TYROGUE
description: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: HITMONTOP
description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: SMOOCHUM
description: It always rocks its head slowly backwards and forwards as if it is trying to kiss someone.

name: ELEKID
description: Even in the most vicious storm, this POKéMON plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

name: MAGBY
description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body heat exceeds 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: MILTANK
description: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

name: BLISSEY
description: It has a very compassionate nature. If it sees a sick POKéMON, it will nurse the sufferer back to health.

name: RAIKOU
description: This POKéMON races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: ENTEI
description: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: SUICUNE
description: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: LARVITAR
description: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

name: PUPITAR
description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: TYRANITAR
description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: LUGIA
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: HO-OH
description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.

name: CELEBI
description: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

name: DEOXYS-A
description: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day's weather.

name: SEISMITOAD
description: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

name: METAGROSSM
description: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

name: SLAKING Z
description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

name: DARKRAI
description: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

name: RESHIRAM
description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

name: ZEKROM
description: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

name: MELOETTA
description: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

name: SLOWBRO-M
description: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: VANILLUXE
description: The shell on it's back is made from soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, it would feel moist.

name: LANDLOS-R
description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries follow POKEMON on it's back

name: COBALION
description: Some POKEMON are born on top of it's back and spend their entire life there.

name: PIKACHU!!!
description: It blows fire through it's nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: GIRATINA
description: When it's internal fire flares up, it's movements grow sharper and faster.

name: DIALGA
description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It cares deeply for it's friends.

name: PALKIA
description: It is very intelligent and calm. They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight.

name: REGIGIGAS
description: It moves along the grass as if sliding. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

name: CRESSELIA
description: It can stop it's opponents movement with just a glare. They give it their all with fighting a powerful foe.

name: MEWTWO
description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

name: KYUREM W
description: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

name: KYUREM B
description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO's cells, making it more powerful.

name: KYUREM
description: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

name: CONARP
description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

name: BLAZARD
description: A POKéMON that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: GENESECT
description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: TREECKO
description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: GROVYLE
description: These pokemon have a big appetite. They coil around their foes and shock them with electricity.

name: SCEPTILE
description: They suck in prey and will attack on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: TORCHIC
description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: COMBUSKEN
description: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: BLAZIKEN
description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.

name: MUDKIP
description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, it's strong pride makes it puff it's chest without care.

name: MARSHTOMP
description: Because every Prinpulp considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: SWAMPERT
description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: TURTWIG
description: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

name: GROTLE
description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

name: TORTERRA
description: It is always hungry because it won't stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can't keep still.

name: TEPIG
description: It is the world's most slothful POKéMON. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: PIGNITE
description: It's jaw power is incredible. It is adapt at biting apart foes while flying at high speed.

name: EMBOAR
description: Spilt into two, the tails are so adapt at handling and doing things, it rarely ever uses it's hands.

name: SNIVY
description: A most peculiar POKéMON that somehow appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA evolves.

name: SERVINE
description: These Pokemon have thought to have been created by science of an ancient civilization.

name: SERPERIOR
description: It is said Golurk protected people and pokemon. It flies across the sky at mach speeds.

name: LOTAD
description: It is said to take lost spirits into it's pilant body and guide them home.

name: LOMBRE
description: It evolves when it recieves electrical stimulation from SHELMET.

name: LUDICOLO
description: The steel armor protects their whole body. They face opponents bravely

name: SEEDOT
description: It utters a deep cry, many murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called the summoner of night.

name: NUZLEAF
description: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.

name: SHIFTRY
description: They live buried in the sands. A dark membrane shields it's eyes from the sun.

name: YANMEGA
description: Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms. It can see surroundings even in darkness.

name: AMBIPOM
description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

name: SHEDINJA
description: Each of it's hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

name: TAILLOW
description: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

name: SWELLOW
description: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

name: SHROOMISH
description: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

name: BRELOOM
description: It's programing was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planed.

name: TYNAMO
description: A group tried to use scientific means to make Magnezone evolve. But their efforts failed.

name: EELEKTRIK
description: It can spit a sticky poisonous liquid. It defends itself by closing the lid of it's shell.

name: EELEKTROSS
description: It is very light and can fight with ninja-like movements. It wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: PIPLUP
description: It is said to have been born from the sun. They shoot fire from their five horns.

name: PRINPULP
description: It is said it's fire provided a replacement for the sun. A sea of fire engulfs their battles.

name: EMPOLEON
description: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The salivia can cause numbness.

name: MAMOSWINE
description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: SANDILE
description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.

name: KROKOROK
description: It is very agile. It extinguishes the flame on it's tail to prevent fires.

name: KROOKODILE
description: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on it's tail to keep it's foe at an ideal distance

name: BALTOY
description: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

name: CLAYDOL
description: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

name: NOSEPASS
description: If anyone were to hurt it's pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: TORKOAL
description: A frozen one was dug up from the soil 10,000 yrs ago. It woke up amazed.

name: SABLEYE
description: Heedless of enemy attacks, it looses high voltage.

name: OSHAWOTT
description: When launching 3,600 degree fireballs, it's body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

name: DEWOTT
description: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

name: SAMUROTT
description: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

name: CORPHISH
description: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

name: CRAWDAUNT
description: These pokemon move in schools. A chain of TYNAMO can be as powerful as lighting.

name: FEEBAS
description: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

name: MILOTIC
description: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

name: CARVANHA
description: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

name: SHARPEDO
description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: TRAPINCH
description: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert's heat.

name: VIBRAVA
description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: FLYGON
description: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA's humming.

name: KARRABLAST
description: Evolution made it more devious. It communicates by clawing signs on boulders.

name: ESCAVALIER
description: It freezes prey by blowing it's 58 degrees F breath. It secretly displays it's prey.

name: SHELMET
description: By controlling it's body heat, it can freeze the atomosphere around it to make diamond flurries.

name: ACCELGOR
description: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

name: ELECTIVIRE
description: It fights using the scalchop on it's stomach. It is made from the same element as it's claws.

name: MAGMORTAR
description: It never neglects it's scalchops. Training is how it learns it's flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: SPHEAL
description: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

name: SEALEO
description: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

name: WALREIN
description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: CACNEA
description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: CACTURNE
description: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

name: SNORUNT
description: When they lined up side by side, no foe can break through. They shielded their young in that way.

name: GLALIE
description: A lifelong jungle dweller from 1000 years ago, it would snap trees with head butts.

name: GLACEON
description: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.

name: LEAFEON
description: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

name: HONCHKROW
description: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

name: SPOINK
description: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud,  depending on the weather.

name: GRUMPIG
description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: LARVESTA
description: It attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes. They absorb minerals they find in rocks.

name: VOLCARONA
description: It fights by sweeping around it's three spiky feelers. A hit from their spikes can turn boulders into rubble.

name: ROSERADE
description: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

name: PORYGON-Z
description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: MAGNEZONE
description: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on it's hand and feet. It will take on any opponent.

name: SWABLU
description: The flowers all over it's body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: ALTARIA
description: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

name: WYNAUT
description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: DUSKULL
description: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: DUSCLOPS
description: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

name: ROSELIA
description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

name: SLAKOTH
description: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

name: VIGOROTH
description: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

name: SLAKING
description: It tends to bite everything, and is not a picky eater. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: CHIMCHAR
description: It two heads do not get along. As a result, they compete for food and end up eating too much.

name: MONFERNO
description: They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything. Anything that moves is considered a target.

name: INFERNAPE
description: It's cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness.

name: GOLETT
description: Part of the armor on it's leg becomes a giant sword. A simple glare can quiet everybody.

name: GOLURK
description: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

name: DUSKNOIR
description: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

name: DEINO
description: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

name: ZWEILOUS
description: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

name: HYDREIGON
description: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won't leave a scratch.

name: ABSOL
description: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

name: FERROSEED
description: It zooms through the sky at 200mph. It's power is strong enough to blow away houses.

name: FERROTHORN
description: It often flies around the Unova Region firing off immense lighting bolts from the spikes on it's tail.

name: FROSLASS
description: The energy pouring from it's tail increases nutrition in the soil. It is known as  The Guardian of the Fields

name: WEAVILE
description: This pokemon brings Victory. It creates an unlimited supply of energy.

name: MISMAGIUS
description: It excels at using leg moves while battling. It can glide across water.

name: ARON
description: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

name: LAIRON
description: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

name: AGGRON
description: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

name: CASTFORM
description: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

name: LICKILICKY
description: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.

name: KIRLIA
description: Cave POKéMON

name: BAGON
description: SMALLEST MODE

name: SALAMENCE
description: POKéMON HABITATS

description: Rare POKéMON
